patterns.note: Full-bleed hero section with dynamic background visuals, followed by a dark, minimal content area featuring a vertical list of project entries.
Prominent, oversized sans-serif headings in the hero contrast with smaller, often uppercase, sans-serif labels and body text, creating a strong typographic hierarchy.

A stark dark mode palette (black/dark grey background with white/light grey text) is used for content sections, while the hero background introduces vibrant, continuously shifting abstract color schemes.
The hero background features a highly dynamic, full-screen visual (likely WebGL/canvas) that continuously transforms its abstract patterns and color palette as the user scrolls down the page.
The main hero headline and supporting text remain fixed in the viewport while the immersive background behind them animates on scroll.
Project listings are presented as a vertical list of text-based entries, each with category tags and a 'VIEW' link, against a dark background.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-screen, interactive background (likely WebGL or canvas-based, leveraging 'canvas' and 'webgl-three' tech) that continuously transforms its visual content and color palette in response to scroll depth, creating a dynamic and immersive experience behind static overlay text.

Subsequent content sections (like the project list) are likely revealed using GSAP ScrollTrigger, animating into view with subtle transitions (e.g., fade-in, slight vertical shift) as they become visible in the viewport, maintaining a clean initial load.
A minimal navigation bar with a logo, hamburger menu, and 'GET IN TOUCH' call-to-action remains sticky at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif hero text (~4-5x body size) with smaller, often uppercase, sans-serif labels and body text, creating strong contrast.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in the hero section, with generous padding around text elements; balanced density in content sections with clear vertical rhythm between list items.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the highly dynamic, full-screen, abstract visual background in the hero section that continuously transforms its patterns and colors on scroll. This creates an immersive, artistic, and memorable first impression, setting it apart from typical static or video hero sections.
